name: Oji
tagline: Tokyo in 22 minutes and Shinjuku in 26 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Kita City, where JR East, Tokyo Metro and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 3 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 26 minutes to Otemachi, 26 minutes to Shinjuku, 31 minutes to Shibuya and 36 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 5.7 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 12.5 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 5.7 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 3.6 m to 16.1 m, a difference of 12.5 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 7 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 3 to 5 m. For storm surge, 2 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is about average for the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 12 clinics and 14 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 桑原病院, about 11 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 愛誠病院, about 25 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station. JR Keihin-Tohoku Line run through it. Tokyo Metro Namboku Line also call here. Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line) are available too. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 1 line, Tokyo Metro runs 1 line and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: JR Keihin-Tohoku Line runs at 159% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 大井町→品川, which this station is not on. Tokyo Metro Namboku Line runs at 156%. Its busiest stretch is 駒込→本駒込, which this station is likewise not on. Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line) is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 2LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the low side. 3 lines and a wide choice of connections pushes the figure up. On the other side, many bars by the station and voices outside late at night holds it down. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Asukayama is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet, but Oji is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Oji. It takes 7 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Oji. One-room rents run about ¥9,000 lower.

leads.groceries: There are 12 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
